First, they create sugar (glucose), which is their plant food that helps them grow big and strong. Second, and even better for us, they let out fresh oxygen! That's the clean air we breathe to live.

So remember: plants use sunlight to turn water and dirty air into sweet food and breathable oxygen. It keeps all life on Earth going!
